title: Verifier-guided discovery of exact high-order mimetic operators with large language models
summary: Designing a high-order structure-preserving discretization is a constrained mathematical search: conservation, a positive discrete inner product, physical spectral behavior, boundary accuracy, bandwidth, and partial differential equation (PDE) error must hold simultaneously. We test whether large language models (LLMs) can help while remaining non-authoritative.
